supporting_quotes.exact: In an AVL tree, the heights of the two child subtrees of any node differ by not more than one; if at any time they differ by more than one, rebalancing is done to restore this property.

observations.subject: AVL tree
observations.object: child subtree heights differ by at most one; rebalancing restores if exceeded

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,185) 完整对应 claim 的两个断言：任一两棵子树高度差不超过 1，以及一旦超过即通过再平衡恢复；引文为该 claim 的直接复述，无信息缺失或冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: Lookup, insertion, and deletion all take O(log n) time in both the average and worst cases, where n is the number of nodes in the tree prior to the operation.

observations.subject: AVL lookups, insertions, deletions
observations.object: in average and worst cases, n = nodes prior to operation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,158) 明确断言查找、插入、删除在平均与最坏情况均为 O(log n)，且 n 为操作前节点数，与 claim 逐项一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: The AVL tree is named after its two Soviet inventors, Georgy Adelson-Velsky and Evgenii Landis, who published it in their 1962 paper "An algorithm for the organization of information". It is the first self-balancing binary search tree data structure to be invented.

observations.subject: AVL tree
observations.object: Georgy Adelson-Velsky and Evgenii Landis, 1962 paper; first self-balancing BST

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,265) 完整支撑 claim 全部要素：两位苏联发明者姓名、1962 年论文标题、最早的自平衡二叉搜索树数据结构，无超出引文的额外断言。

supporting_quotes.exact: Balance factor of a node in an AVL tree is the difference between the height of the left subtree and that of the right subtree of that node.

observations.subject: AVL node balance factor
observations.object: left subtree height minus right subtree height

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,140) 与 claim 定义一致：平衡因子等于左子树高度与右子树高度之差，术语与方向均对应。

supporting_quotes.exact: The self balancing property of an avl tree is maintained by the balance factor. The value of balance factor should always be -1, 0 or +1.

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,137) 断言自平衡性质由平衡因子维护且其值应恒为 -1、0 或 +1，与 claim 完整复述一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: In rotation operation, the positions of the nodes of a subtree are interchanged.

observations.subject: rotation operation
observations.object: positions of nodes of a subtree

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,80) 说明旋转操作交换子树中节点的位置，与 claim 措辞一致，无冲突信息。

supporting_quotes.exact: Right Right: X is rebalanced with a simple rotation rotate_Left. Left Left: X is rebalanced with a simple rotation rotate_Right (mirror-image). Right Left: X is rebalanced with a double rotation rotate_RightLeft. Left Right: X is rebalanced with a double rotation rotate_LeftRight (mirror-image).

observations.subject: AVL four imbalance cases
observations.object: RR to rotate_Left, LL to rotate_Right (mirror), RL to rotate_RightLeft, LR to rotate_LeftRight (mirror)

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,295) 四种情形与 claim 逐一对应：RR 单旋 rotate_Left、LL 单旋 rotate_Right（镜像）、RL 双旋 rotate_RightLeft、LR 双旋 rotate_LeftRight（镜像），无偏离。

supporting_quotes.exact: Since with a single deletion the height of an AVL subtree cannot decrease by more than one, the temporary balance factor of a node will be in the range from −2 to +2. If the balance factor remains in the range from −1 to +1 it can be adjusted in accord with the AVL rules. If it becomes ±2 then the subtree is unbalanced and needs to be rotated.

observations.subject: single AVL deletion
observations.object: height decrease at most 1; temporary balance factor in −2..+2; ±2 requires rotation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,344) 依次断言高度至多下降 1、临时平衡因子落在 −2..+2、在 −1..+1 内可按 AVL 规则调整、为 ±2 则失衡需旋转，与 claim 完全对应。引文含 U+2212 与 U+00B1 码点，按码点计长。

supporting_quotes.exact: RB insertions and deletions and AVL insertions require from zero to three tail-recursive rotations and run in amortized O(1) time, thus equally constant on average. AVL deletions requiring O(log n) rotations in the worst case are also O(1) on average.

observations.subject: AVL insertions and deletions
observations.object: insertions 0-3 tail-recursive rotations amortized O(1); deletions O(log n) worst-case rotations O(1) average

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,266) 的 AVL 子句与 claim 一致：插入需 0 到 3 次尾递归旋转且摊还 O(1) 时间，删除最坏 O(log n) 次旋转、平均 O(1)。引文中同句包含的 RB 内容与 AVL 子句不构成冲突，claim 仅提取 AVL 部分。

supporting_quotes.exact: AVL trees are often compared with red–black trees because both support the same set of operations and take O(log n) time for the basic operations. For lookup-intensive applications, AVL trees are faster than red–black trees because they are more strictly balanced.

observations.subject: AVL vs red-black trees
observations.object: same operation set and O(log n) basic operations; AVL faster for lookup-intensive due to stricter balance

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,263) 支持 claim 的全部三个断言：常被比较、操作集合相同且基本操作为 O(log n)、查找密集型应用因平衡更严格而更快（en dash U+2013 按单一码点计长）。

supporting_quotes.exact: Indeed, every AVL tree can be colored red–black, but there are RB trees which are not AVL balanced.

observations.subject: AVL and RB tree relation
observations.object: every AVL tree can be colored red-black; some RB trees are not AVL balanced

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,100) 与 claim 的两个量化命题一致：每个 AVL 树可染成红黑树，且存在不是 AVL 平衡的红黑树。

claims.rationale: claim 由两个并列应用组成，第一条引文 [0,39) 支撑大记录索引子句，第二条引文 [0,32) 支撑大型数据库检索子句，两句分别对应且无冲突。两条引文同源（programiz-avl-tree-v2 同一列表页），不构成独立佐证。
